examples.chinese: 哥哥喜歡在床上看書。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐhuān zài chuáng shàng kànshū.
examples.english: My elder brother likes to read in bed.

examples.chinese: 我今天七點起床。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.english: I get up at 7:00 today.

examples.chinese: 我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

examples.chinese: A:你每天幾點起床？ B:差不多七點。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng? B: Chàbuduō qī diǎn.
examples.english: A: What time do you get up every day? B: About seven o'clock.

examples.chinese: 爸爸每天早上一起床就看報紙。
examples.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang yì qǐchuáng jiù kàn bàozhǐ.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as Dad gets out of bed, he reads the newspaper.

examples.chinese: 哥哥只要睡前喝太多水，就會夢到半夜起床找不到廁所，這樣的夢真可怕！
examples.pinyin: Gēge zhǐyào shuì qián hē tài duō shuǐ, jiù huì mèng dào bànyè qǐchuáng zhǎo bù dào cèsuǒ, zhèyàng de mèng zhēn kěpà!
examples.english: As long as my older brother drinks too much water before bed, he dreams of getting up in the middle of the night and not being able to find the toilet; such a dream is really scary!

examples.chinese: 我每天睡覺前都會把明天的早餐預備好，這樣一起床只要加熱就能吃了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shuìjiào qián dōu huì bǎ míngtiān de zǎocān yùbèi hǎo, zhèyàng yī qǐchuáng zhǐyào jiārè jiù néng chī le.
examples.english: Every day before going to bed, I prepare tomorrow's breakfast, so that as soon as I get up, I just need to heat it up and can eat.

items.wordHook: Under a 广(broad) roof rests a 木(tree) frame → the 床(bed).

examples.chinese: 這張畫很好看，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng huà hěn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: This painting is brilliant. I like it very much.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子很喜歡畫畫，他畫得很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn xǐhuān huàhuà, tā huà de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That child likes painting and he draws very well.

examples.chinese: 黑板上畫著一條河、一個湖，學生們還想畫一些山和房子。
examples.pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng huàzhe yī tiáo hé, yī gè hú, xuéshēngmen hái xiǎng huà yīxiē shān hé fángzi.
examples.english: On the blackboard, a river and a lake are drawn; the students also want to draw some mountains and houses.

examples.chinese: 他的計畫是畢業以後到美國去工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shì bìyè yǐhòu dào Měiguó qù gōngzuò.
examples.english: His plan is to go to the United States to work after graduation.

examples.chinese: 何小姐是一名模特兒，也會自己設計服裝，這幾張圖裡的裙子都是她畫的。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě shì yī míng mótè'ér, yě huì zìjǐ shèjì fúzhuāng, zhè jǐ zhāng tú lǐ de qúnzi dōu shì tā huà de.
examples.english: Miss He is a model and can also design clothes herself. The skirts in these pictures were all drawn by her.

examples.chinese: 我家的狗很乖，從不破壞家裡的東西。颱風快來了，破壞了我本來要去露營的計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de gǒu hěn guāi, cóng bù pòhuài jiālǐ de dōngxī. Táifēng kuài lái le, pòhuài le wǒ běnlái yào qù lùyíng de jìhuà.
examples.english: Our dog is very well-behaved and never destroys things in the house. The typhoon is coming soon, and it destroyed my original plan to go camping.

examples.chinese: 這個星期經理一連寫了三個推銷新產品的計畫，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī jīnglǐ yīlián xiě le sān gè tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de jìhuà, měi tiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: This week the manager wrote three plans for promoting new products in succession; he is extremely busy every day.

examples.chinese: 每年冬天快到時，舅舅和舅媽就開始計畫去滑雪，有時還約我跟媽媽一起去。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dōngtiān kuài dào shí, jiùjiu hé jiùmā jiù kāishǐ jìhuà qù huáxuě, yǒushí hái yuē wǒ gēn māma yīqǐ qù.
examples.english: Every year when winter is approaching, my uncle and aunt start planning to go skiing, and sometimes they even invite me and my mom to go together.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: 臺北美術館最近舉辦了很有名的畫展，吸引了很多民眾去欣賞那些畫。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi Měishùguǎn zuìjìn jǔbàn le hěn yǒumíng de huàzhǎn, xīyǐn le hěn duō mínzhòng qù xīnshǎng nàxiē huà.
examples.english: The Taipei Fine Arts Museum recently held a very famous painting exhibition, attracting many people to go appreciate those paintings.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 我的法國朋友最初只計畫來臺灣學中文，沒想到後來拿到了獎學金，還念了博士班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyǒu zuìchū zhǐ jìhuà lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, méi xiǎngdào hòulái nádàole jiǎngxuéjīn, hái niànle bóshìbān.
examples.english: At first, my French friend only planned to come to Taiwan to study Chinese; unexpectedly, later he received a scholarship and even studied in a doctoral program.

examples.chinese: 這個改善空氣品質的計畫，已經實行三年了，還需要一段時間才能看到成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǎishàn kōngqì pǐnzhí de jìhuà, yǐjīng shíxíng sān nián le, hái xūyào yī duàn shíjiān cái néng kàndào chéngguǒ.
examples.english: This plan to improve air quality has already been carried out for three years; it still needs some time before results can be seen.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 那位畫家的作品十分生動，畫裡的人物好像真的能從畫裡走出來一樣。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi huàjiā de zuòpǐn shífēn shēngdòng, huà lǐ de rénwù hǎoxiàng zhēn de néng cóng huà lǐ zǒu chūlái yīyàng.
examples.english: That painter's works are extremely vivid; the figures in the paintings seem as if they could really walk out of the paintings.

examples.chinese: 這本書有豐富的內容及生動的鉛筆畫，是吸引讀者購買的主要原因。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒu fēngfù de nèiróng jí shēngdòng de qiānbǐhuà, shì xīyǐn dúzhě gòumǎi de zhǔyào yuányīn.
examples.english: This book has rich content and lively pencil drawings, which are the main reasons that attract readers to buy it.

examples.chinese: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking.

examples.chinese: 古小姐做事的態度很積極，為了完成任務，總是很早就做好計畫，而且立刻實行。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiǎojiě zuòshì de tàidù hěn jījí, wèile wánchéng rènwù, zǒngshì hěn zǎo jiù zuò hǎo jìhuà, érqiě lìkè shíxíng.
examples.english: Miss Gu has a very proactive attitude toward work. In order to complete tasks, she always makes plans early and immediately carries them out.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese: 這個房子的房租不包括水費、電費。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángzi de fángzū bù bāokuò shuǐfèi, diànfèi.
examples.english: The rent for this house does not include the water fee and electricity fee.

examples.chinese: 付了房租以後，你這個月的獎學金還剩多少？弟弟把菜都吃完了，什麼都沒剩。
examples.pinyin: Fù le fángzū yǐhòu, nǐ zhège yuè de jiǎngxuéjīn hái shèng duōshǎo? Dìdi bǎ cài dōu chī wán le, shénme dōu méi shèng.
examples.english: After paying the rent, how much of this month's scholarship do you still have left? My little brother ate all the food; nothing is left.

examples.chinese: 我的房東都是每個月五號來收房租的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángdōng dōu shì měi ge yuè wǔ hào lái shōu fángzū de.
examples.english: My landlord always comes to collect the rent on the fifth of every month.

examples.chinese: 我的房租每個月一萬塊，加上水費、電費，差不多一萬三。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángzū měi gè yuè yī wàn kuài, jiāshàng shuǐfèi, diànfèi, chàbuduō yī wàn sān.
examples.english: My rent is 10,000 dollars a month; plus water and electricity fees, it's about 13,000.

examples.chinese: 這個房子又大又舒服，房租只要三千塊，真是太便宜了！
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángzi yòu dà yòu shūfu, fángzū zhǐyào sānqiān kuài, zhēn shì tài piányi le!
examples.english: This house is both big and comfortable, and the rent is only 3,000 dollars—it's really too cheap!

examples.chinese: 他這個月花了太多錢，因此連水電費、房租都繳不出來。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège yuè huā le tài duō qián, yīncǐ lián shuǐdiànfèi, fángzū dōu jiǎo bù chūlái.
examples.english: He spent too much money this month, so he can't even pay his water and electricity bills and rent.

examples.chinese: 這種巧克力冰淇淋又便宜又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qiǎokèlì bīngqílín yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
examples.english: This kind of chocolate ice cream is both cheap and delicious.

examples.chinese: 我很喜歡這家店的巧克力蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zhè jiā diàn de qiǎokèlì dàngāo.
examples.english: I like the chocolate cake from this shop.

examples.chinese: 他們有巧克力冰淇淋嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yǒu qiǎokèlì bīngqílín ma?
examples.english: Do they have chocolate ice cream?

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng. Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english: Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance. My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese: 在追求夢想的路上，會遇到很困難的事情，只有不斷努力，才能完成夢想。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang, huì yùdào hěn kùnnan de shìqing, zhǐyǒu bùduàn nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, you will encounter very difficult things; only by making continuous efforts can you fulfill your dreams.

examples.chinese: 想要得到好成績，除了努力用功，還得學習怎麼利用網路資源。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào dédào hǎo chéngjī, chúle nǔlì yònggōng, hái děi xuéxí zěnme lìyòng wǎnglù zīyuán.
examples.english: If you want to get good grades, besides working hard, you also need to learn how to use online resources.

examples.chinese: 媽媽替我報名了亞洲鋼琴比賽，她說只要我肯努力，一定會有好成績的。
examples.pinyin: Māma tì wǒ bàomíngle Yàzhōu gāngqín bǐsài, tā shuō zhǐyào wǒ kěn nǔlì, yīdìng huì yǒu hǎo chéngjī de.
examples.english: My mother signed me up for the Asian Piano Competition. She said that as long as I am willing to work hard, I will definitely get good results.

examples.chinese: A:我希望將來能當一名很棒的導演。 B:我相信只要你不斷地努力，就能夢想成真的！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng yī míng hěn bàng de dǎoyǎn. B: Wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào nǐ bùduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de!
examples.english: A: I hope that in the future I can become a great director. B: I believe that as long as you keep working hard, your dreams will come true!

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 李小姐的外語能力很強，也在歐洲工作過，我覺得這個翻譯工作很適合她。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě de wàiyǔ nénglì hěn qiáng, yě zài Ōuzhōu gōngzuò guò, wǒ juéde zhège fānyì gōngzuò hěn shìhé tā.
examples.english: Miss Li's foreign language ability is very strong, and she has also worked in Europe; I think this translation job is very suitable for her.

examples.chinese: 我烤了很多巧克力餅乾，用好看的紙包了一些送給鄰居。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kǎo le hěn duō qiǎokèlì bǐnggān, yòng hǎokàn de zhǐ bāo le yìxiē sòng gěi línjū.
examples.english: I baked a lot of chocolate cookies and packed some in pretty paper to give to my neighbors.

examples.chinese: 超商常舉辦送小禮物或買一送一的活動，可是對王先生完全沒有吸引力。
examples.pinyin: Chāoshāng cháng jǔbàn sòng xiǎo lǐwù huò mǎi yī sòng yī de huódòng, kěshì duì Wáng xiānsheng wánquán méiyǒu xīyǐnlì.
examples.english: Convenience stores often hold promotions giving small gifts or buy-one-get-one-free, but they have completely no appeal to Mr. Wang.

examples.chinese: 章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī, jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang has always wanted to be a lawyer. After years of effort, his dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 救災工作不容易，一個人的力量是不夠的，得大家一起來。
examples.pinyin: Jiùzāi gōngzuò bù róngyì, yí ge rén de lìliàng shì bú gòu de, děi dàjiā yìqǐ lái.
examples.english: Disaster relief work is not easy; one person's strength is not enough—everyone needs to come together.

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese: 那家店正在推銷巧克力口味的小籠包，我們要不要去嘗試一下？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zhèngzài tuīxiāo qiǎokèlì kǒuwèi de xiǎolóngbāo, wǒmen yào bù yào qù chángshì yīxià?
examples.english: That shop is promoting chocolate-flavored soup dumplings; shall we go try them?

examples.chinese: 珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì. Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension. Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 地震後救災人員把握分分秒秒，努力把被困在房子底下的民眾救出來。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu jiùzāi rényuán bǎwò fēnfēnmiǎomiǎo, nǔlì bǎ bèi kùn zài fángzi dǐxia de mínzhòng jiù chūlái.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the rescue workers seized every minute and every second, striving to rescue the people trapped under the houses.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 小在追求夢想的路上，別太在意別人說什麼，只要不斷地努力，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshàng, bié tài zàiyì biérén shuō shénme, zhǐyào búduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, don't care too much about what others say; as long as you keep working hard, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 參加這次總統選舉的人實力都不錯，最後是陳先生當選了。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā zhè cì zǒngtǒng xuǎnjǔ de rén shílì dōu bùcuò, zuìhòu shì Chén xiānsheng dāngxuǎn le.
examples.english: The people who participated in this presidential election all had good qualifications; in the end, Mr. Chen was elected.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 我的漢字考試總是不及格，經過三個月努力地練習，終於及格了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Hànzì kǎoshì zǒngshì bù jígé, jīngguò sān ge yuè nǔlì de liànxí, zhōngyú jígé le.
examples.english: I always fail my Chinese character exams; after three months of hard practice, I finally passed.

examples.chinese: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn chúle yǒu péiyǎng xuéshēng Zhōngwén nénglì de kèchéng, hái ānpái le wénhuà kè, ràng kèchéng gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: The Mandarin center, besides having courses that develop students' Chinese ability, also arranged culture classes, making the courses richer.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺年紀大了，不但體力不好，還有頭痛、肩膀痛的毛病。我家的洗衣機用了二十多年了，毛病真不少，可是媽媽還不肯換新的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye niánjì dà le, bùdàn tǐlì bù hǎo, hái yǒu tóutòng, jiānbǎng tòng de máobìng. Wǒ jiā de xǐyījī yòng le èrshí duō nián le, máobìng zhēn bù shǎo, kěshì māma hái bù kěn huàn xīn de.
examples.english: My grandpa is old; not only is his physical strength poor, but he also has the problem of headaches and shoulder pain. Our washing machine has been used for over twenty years and has quite a few problems, but Mom still won't agree to replace it with a new one.

examples.chinese: A:小張病了三天了，不但全身沒力，還發高燒。 B:最近很多人都這樣，應該是感冒了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiǎo Zhāng bìng le sān tiān le, bùdàn quánshēn méi lì, hái fā gāoshāo. B: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén dōu zhèyàng, yīnggāi shì gǎnmào le.
examples.english: A: Xiao Zhang has been ill for three days; not only does his whole body have no strength, but he also has a high fever. B: Many people have been like this recently; it's probably a cold.

examples.chinese: 每個人一輩子都會遇到像沒考上大學、找不到工作那樣的挫折，但只要努力就有希望。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén yībèizi dōu huì yùdào xiàng méi kǎoshàng dàxué, zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò nàyàng de cuòzhé, dàn zhǐyào nǔlì jiù yǒu xīwàng.
examples.english: Everyone will encounter frustrations like not getting into university or not finding a job in their lifetime, but as long as you work hard, there is hope.

examples.chinese: 小連跟老闆吵架而離開了公司，為了讓家人能繼續過安定的生活，他正努力地找新工作。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lián gēn lǎobǎn chǎojià ér líkāi le gōngsī, wèile ràng jiārén néng jìxù guò āndìng de shēnghuó, tā zhèng nǔlì de zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Xiao Lian left the company after quarreling with the boss; in order to let his family continue to live a safe and stable life, he is working hard to find a new job.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 有一份研究報告表示，對陌生環境適應能力越強的人，未來成功的機會也越高。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yī fèn yánjiū bàogào biǎoshì, duì mòshēng huánjìng shìyìng nénglì yuè qiáng de rén, wèilái chénggōng de jīhuì yě yuè gāo.
examples.english: A research report indicates that the stronger a person's ability to adapt to unfamiliar environments, the higher their chances of success in the future.

examples.chinese: 易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng cóng zhíchǎng tuìxiū hòu, jiù jiārù le yīyuàn de fúwù shètuán, jìxù wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.
examples.english: After Mr. Yi retired from the workplace, he joined the hospital's service club and continued to contribute his part to society.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文的聽力水平，我除了聽收音機的英文廣播，也會看美國的電視新聞。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le tígāo Yīngwén de tīnglì shuǐpíng, wǒ chú le tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō, yě huì kàn Měiguó de diànshì xīnwén.
examples.english: In order to improve my English listening level, besides listening to English radio broadcasts, I also watch American TV news.

examples.chinese: 溫小姐在白色情人節那天，送給情人一盒巧克力。
examples.pinyin: Wēn xiǎojiě zài Báisè Qíngrén Jié nà tiān, sòng gěi qíngrén yì hé qiǎokèlì.
examples.english: On White Day, Miss Wen gave her lover a box of chocolates.

examples.chinese: 他努力了三年，終於考上了最好的大學，他激動得流下了眼淚。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǔlì le sān nián, zhōngyú kǎoshàng le zuì hǎo de dàxué, tā jīdòng de liú xià le yǎnlèi.
examples.english: He worked hard for three years and finally got into the best university; he was so excited that he shed tears.

examples.chinese: 這支手錶是我過世的爺爺留給我的，對我來說具有特別的意義。我的老闆具有獨特的領導魅力， 員工都願意跟著他努力工作。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè zhī shǒubiǎo shì wǒ guòshì de yéye liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō jùyǒu tèbié de yìyì. 2. Wǒ de lǎobǎn jùyǒu dútè de lǐngdǎo mèilì, yuángōng dōu yuànyì gēnzhe tā nǔlì gōngzuò.
examples.english: 1. This watch was left to me by my late grandfather; to me, it has special significance. 2. My boss has a unique leadership charisma; the employees are all willing to work hard following him.

items.wordHook: A bent arm flexes its bicep into a hard knot → 力(strength).

examples.chinese: 在台灣，很多年輕人喜歡當咖啡店的老闆。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, hěn duō niánqīngrén xǐhuān dāng kāfēi diàn de lǎobǎn.
examples.english: In Taiwan, many young people like to be the boss of a coffee shop.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕人喜歡聽流行音樂。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng rén xǐhuān tīng liúxíng yīnyuè.
examples.english: Many young people like to listen to popular music.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 金小姐穿上這件淺色的上衣， 看起來更年輕、更有精神了。這個衣櫃有點兒淺，這件厚大衣掛不進去，就算掛進去了， 門也關不起來。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiǎojiě chuān shàng zhè jiàn qiǎnsè de shàngyī, kàn qǐlái gèng niánqīng, gèng yǒu jīngshén le. Zhège yīguì yǒudiǎnr qiǎn, zhè jiàn hòu dàyī guà bù jìnqù, jiùsuàn guà jìnqù le, mén yě guān bù qǐlái.
examples.english: When Miss Jin puts on this light-colored top, she looks younger and more energetic. This wardrobe is a bit shallow; this thick coat can't hang inside, and even if it could, the door wouldn't close.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽很會保養，看起來又年輕又漂亮，很多人都以為我們是姊妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma hěn huì bǎoyǎng, kàn qǐlái yòu niánqīng yòu piàoliang, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒmen shì jiěmèi.
examples.english: My mother is very good at taking care of herself; she looks both young and pretty, and many people think we are sisters.

examples.chinese: 小戴才三十歲就已經是名牌服裝公司的大老闆，這麼年輕就有這樣的成就，實在不簡單。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài cái sānshí suì jiù yǐjīng shì míngpái fúzhuāng gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn, zhème niánqīng jiù yǒu zhèyàng de chéngjiù, shízài bù jiǎndān.
examples.english: Little Dai is only thirty years old and is already the big boss of a famous brand clothing company; to have such accomplishments at such a young age is really not simple.

examples.chinese: 老師說這次口試的題目不難，回答是只要放輕鬆、別緊張，就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō zhè cì kǒushì de tímù bù nán, huídá shì zhǐyào fàng qīngsōng, bié jǐnzhāng, jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: The teacher said the questions on this oral exam are not hard; the answer is that as long as you relax and don't be nervous, there's no problem.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 人人都喜歡薪水高、離家近、輕鬆的工作，不過這往往只是一個夢。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu xǐhuan xīnshuǐ gāo, lí jiā jìn, qīngsōng de gōngzuò, búguò zhè wǎngwǎng zhǐshì yí ge mèng.
examples.english: Everyone likes a job with a high salary, close to home, and easy, but this is often just a dream.

examples.chinese: 連先生很年輕的時候就當了國小校長，當年他才三十歲。
examples.pinyin: Lián xiānsheng hěn niánqīng de shíhou jiù dāng le guóxiǎo xiàozhǎng, dāngnián tā cái sānshí suì.
examples.english: Mr. Lian became an elementary school principal when he was very young; in those days he was only thirty years old.

examples.chinese: 王老先生年輕時就離開了家鄉，他很想回老家去看看親人。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoxiānsheng niánqīng shí jiù líkāi le jiāxiāng, tā hěn xiǎng huí lǎojiā qù kànkan qīnrén.
examples.english: Mr. Wang left his hometown when he was young; he really wants to go back to his old home to see his relatives.

examples.chinese: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.
examples.english: Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese: 小周才三十歲，就去過四十幾個國家，甚至去過一些又危險又刺激的地方，真是太酷了！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu cái sānshí suì, jiù qùguò sìshí jǐ gè guójiā, shènzhì qùguò yīxiē yòu wēixiǎn yòu cìjī de dìfāng, zhēn shì tài kù le!
examples.english: Xiao Zhou is only thirty years old, but has already been to over forty countries, and even some dangerous and exciting places—that's really so cool!

examples.chinese: 弟弟做了一個可怕的夢，夜裡三點就醒了。台灣的夏天熱極了，要是房間沒有冷氣，半夜可能會被熱醒，甚至整個晚上睡不著。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zuò le yí ge kěpà de mèng, yèlǐ sān diǎn jiù xǐng le. Táiwān de xiàtiān rè jí le, yàoshi fángjiān méiyǒu lěngqì, bànyè kěnéng huì bèi rè xǐng, shènzhì zhěnggè wǎnshang shuì bù zháo.
examples.english: My younger brother had a scary dream and woke up at 3 a.m. Summers in Taiwan are extremely hot; if the room has no air conditioning, you might be woken up by the heat in the middle of the night, or even be unable to sleep all night.

examples.chinese: 大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day. The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

examples.chinese: 過年時，著名點心店都會收到大量的訂單，甚至有顧客在半年前就下訂單了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí, zhùmíng diǎnxīn diàn dōu huì shōudào dàliàng de dìngdān, shènzhì yǒu gùkè zài bàn nián qián jiù xià dìngdān le.
examples.english: During Chinese New Year, famous pastry shops receive a large number of orders; some customers even place orders half a year in advance.

examples.chinese: 網路直播的內容各種各樣，甚至有人因為直播平日生活而變成明星。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhíbō de nèiróng gèzhǒng-gèyàng, shènzhì yǒu rén yīnwèi zhíbō píngrì shēnghuó ér biànchéng míngxīng.
examples.english: The content of live internet broadcasts is all kinds of things; some people even become stars because they live-broadcast their everyday life.

items.wordHook: Combining 甚(considerably) and 至(reach): 甚至 means even.

examples.chinese: 我在山上工作，手機的訊號很弱，朋友常抱怨我的電話不是打不通，就是聲音不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài shānshàng gōngzuò, shǒujī de xìnhào hěn ruò, péngyǒu cháng bàoyuàn wǒ de diànhuà bú shì dǎ bù tōng, jiù shì shēngyīn bù qīngchu.
examples.english: I work in the mountains, and the cell phone signal is very weak. My friends often complain that my phone either can't be reached or the voice is unclear.

items.wordHook: A brittle hunting 弓(bow) frozen over by delicate crystals of 冫(ice) snaps easily because it is too 弱(weak).

examples.chinese: 史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎnchá guo hǎojǐ cì, háishi bèi tā fāxiàn le jǐ ge cuòzì.
examples.english: Ms. Shi is very careful in her work; I checked this form several times, but she still found a few typos.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese: 他個性獨立，加上做事總是很細心，因此老闆很欣賞他。
examples.pinyin: Tā gèxìng dúlì, jiāshàng zuòshì zǒngshì hěn xìxīn, yīncǐ lǎobǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: He has an independent personality; on top of that, he is always very careful in doing things, so the boss appreciates him very much.

examples.chinese: 妹妹提了一個小桶水，很細心地幫爸爸擦櫃子。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei tí le yī gè xiǎo tǒng shuǐ, hěn xìxīn de bāng bàba cā guìzi.
examples.english: My younger sister carried a small bucket of water and carefully helped Dad wipe the cabinet.

examples.chinese: 那家報社非常細心，他們的文章從沒出現過一個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā bàoshè fēicháng xìxīn, tāmen de wénzhāng cóng méi chūxiànguò yí gè cuòzì.
examples.english: That newspaper publisher is very careful; their articles have never had a single typo.

examples.chinese: 這幅設計圖畫得很仔細，畫圖的人應該相當細心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú shèjì tú huà de hěn zǐxì, huà tú de rén yīnggāi xiāngdāng xìxīn.
examples.english: This design drawing is drawn very carefully; the person who drew it must be quite meticulous.

items.wordHook: Combining 細(fine) and 心(heart): 細心 means careful.

examples.chinese: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de huìyì zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, zhèyàng yòu ānquán yòu fāngbiàn, gè bùmén yě néng suíshí cānkǎo.
examples.english: The company's meeting materials are all stored in the cloud; this way it is both safe and convenient, and each department can also refer to them at any time.

examples.chinese: 老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān bǎ gēn kèchéng xiāngguān de xuéxí zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí.
examples.english: The teacher first uploads the course-related learning materials to the cloud for students to preview.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì zīliào wǒ yǐjīng shàngchuán dào yúnduān, qǐng gèwèi kāihuì qián xiān liǎojiě yào tǎolùn de nèiróng.
examples.english: I have already uploaded tomorrow's meeting materials to the cloud; please understand the content to be discussed before the meeting.

examples.chinese: 幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
examples.pinyin: 1. Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái. 2. Xìngkuī wǒ bǎ zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàobùrán zhǎo bú dào suíshēndié, zěnme kāihuì ne?
examples.english: 1. Thanks to your help, otherwise I definitely wouldn't be able to handle it alone. 2. Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

examples.chinese: 在雲端科技發達的時代裡，人人都能夠透過網路交友、學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài yúnduān kējì fādá de shídài lǐ, rénrén dōu nénggòu tòuguò wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, xuéxí.
examples.english: In an era of advanced cloud technology, everyone can make friends and learn through the internet.

examples.chinese: 太太：要是你閒著沒事，就幫我泡一壺熱茶吧。先生：我哪裡閒？我馬上要開雲端會議了，可是忙得很呢！
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Yàoshi nǐ xián zhe méishì, jiù bāng wǒ pào yī hú rè chá ba. Xiānsheng: Wǒ nǎlǐ xián? Wǒ mǎshàng yào kāi yúnduān huìyì le, kěshì máng de hěn ne!
examples.english: Wife: If you're idle with nothing to do, then help me brew a pot of hot tea. Husband: How am I idle? I'm about to start a cloud meeting; I'm really busy!

examples.chinese: 這家公司出版的小說，陪著不少讀者一塊兒成長，也帶給他們無窮的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chūbǎn de xiǎoshuō, péi zhe bùshǎo dúzhě yíkuàir chéngzhǎng, yě dài gěi tāmen wúqióng de lèqù.
examples.english: The novels published by this company have accompanied many readers as they grew up, and have also brought them endless joy.

items.wordHook: Having 無(no) trace of 窮(poor): 無窮 means endless.

examples.chinese: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal.

examples.chinese: 王教授有一本古書，那本書已經有幾百年的歷史了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu yǒu yī běn gǔ shū, nà běn shū yǐjīng yǒu jǐ bǎi nián de lìshǐ le.
examples.english: Professor Wang has an old book; that book already has several hundred years of history.

examples.chinese: 因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiángliè táifēng de guānxì, jīchǎng yǐjīng guān le, děng fēng xiǎo yīdiǎn cái huì zài kāifàng.
examples.english: Because of the strong typhoon, the airport has already closed; it will open again only after the wind gets a little weaker.

examples.chinese: 這座古蹟已經有兩百多年的歷史。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔjì yǐjīng yǒu liǎngbǎi duō nián de lìshǐ.
examples.english: This ancient relic already has a history of more than two hundred years.

examples.chinese: 站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le. 2. Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english: 1. The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow. 2. Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: 明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì zīliào wǒ yǐjīng shàngchuán dào yúnduān, qǐng gèwèi kāihuì qián xiān liǎojiě yào tǎolùn de nèiróng.
examples.english: I have already uploaded tomorrow's meeting materials to the cloud; please understand the content to be discussed before the meeting.

examples.chinese: 小張已經四十歲了，父母盼望他快點找到結婚對象，他卻一點也不著急。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎozhāng yǐjīng sìshí suì le, fùmǔ pànwàng tā kuài diǎn zhǎodào jiéhūn duìxiàng, tā què yīdiǎn yě bù zháojí.
examples.english: Xiaozhang is already forty years old; his parents yearn for him to quickly find a marriage partner, but he is not anxious at all.

examples.chinese: 這個改善空氣品質的計畫，已經實行三年了，還需要一段時間才能看到成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǎishàn kōngqì pǐnzhí de jìhuà, yǐjīng shíxíng sān nián le, hái xūyào yī duàn shíjiān cái néng kàndào chéngguǒ.
examples.english: This plan to improve air quality has already been carried out for three years; it still needs some time before results can be seen.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 小章已經結婚了，還常常跟其他女生約會，真是太花心了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng yǐjīng jiéhūn le, hái chángcháng gēn qítā nǚshēng yuēhuì, zhēn shì tài huāxīn le.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang is already married, yet he often dates other girls; he is really too womanizing.

examples.chinese: 這家電腦公司本來只服務亞洲地區的民眾，現在服務範圍已經擴大到歐洲了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diànnǎo gōngsī běnlái zhǐ fúwù Yàzhōu dìqū de mínzhòng, xiànzài fúwù fànwéi yǐjīng kuòdà dào Ōuzhōu le.
examples.english: This computer company originally only served people in the Asian region, but now its service range has already expanded to Europe.

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 這個手錶你已經戴了快二十年了吧？他對你有甚麼特殊的意義呢？
examples.pinyin: Zhège shǒubiǎo nǐ yǐjīng dài le kuài èrshí nián le ba? Tā duì nǐ yǒu shénme tèshū de yìyì ne?
examples.english: You have already worn this watch for almost twenty years, right? Does it have any special meaning to you?

examples.chinese: 小戴才三十歲就已經是名牌服裝公司的大老闆，這麼年輕就有這樣的成就，實在不簡單。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài cái sānshí suì jiù yǐjīng shì míngpái fúzhuāng gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn, zhème niánqīng jiù yǒu zhèyàng de chéngjiù, shízài bù jiǎndān.
examples.english: Little Dai is only thirty years old and is already the big boss of a famous brand clothing company; to have such accomplishments at such a young age is really not simple.

examples.chinese: 因為工作太忙的關係，夏小姐已經有一段時間沒上街購物了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng de guānxì, Xià xiǎojiě yǐjīng yǒu yī duàn shíjiān méi shàngjiē gòuwù le.
examples.english: Because she is too busy with work, Miss Xia has not gone out shopping for some time.

examples.chinese: 這個城市的變化很大，不少老房屋已經變成新大樓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de biànhuà hěn dà, bùshǎo lǎo fángwū yǐjīng biànchéng xīn dàlóu le.
examples.english: This city has changed a lot; many old houses have already turned into new high-rise buildings.

examples.chinese: 記者說參加這次慢跑活動的人數已經超過了一百人，可是我數來數去只有五十幾個。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě shuō cānjiā zhè cì mànpǎo huódòng de rénshù yǐjīng chāoguò le yìbǎi rén, kěshì wǒ shǔ lái shǔ qù zhǐyǒu wǔshí jǐ ge.
examples.english: The reporter said the number of people participating in this jogging event has already exceeded one hundred, but I counted and counted and there were only fifty-some.

examples.chinese: 小白喝了太多酒，已經醉了，不能讓他繼續喝了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bái hē le tài duō jiǔ, yǐjīng zuì le, bùnéng ràng tā jìxù hē le.
examples.english: Xiao Bai has drunk too much alcohol and is already drunk; we can't let him keep drinking.

examples.chinese: 滑雪是很刺激的活動，需要很好的技巧。李小姐受不了離婚的刺激，已經好幾天吃不好、睡不好了。
examples.pinyin: Huáxuě shì hěn cìjī de huódòng, xūyào hěn hǎo de jìqiǎo. Lǐ xiǎojiě shòu bù liǎo líhūn de cìjī, yǐjīng hǎo jǐ tiān chī bù hǎo, shuì bù hǎo le.
examples.english: Skiing is a very exciting activity that requires good skills. Miss Li couldn't handle the shock of divorce, and has been unable to eat or sleep well for several days.

examples.chinese: 現在大家都習慣用手機照相，一般的相機已經越來越少人使用了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài dàjiā dōu xíguàn yòng shǒujī zhàoxiàng, yìbān de xiàngjī yǐjīng yuèláiyuè shǎo rén shǐyòng le.
examples.english: Nowadays everyone is used to using their cell phones to take pictures; fewer and fewer people use regular cameras.

examples.chinese: 我室友的生活習慣很差，我已經忍耐他很久了，真希望他馬上搬走。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shìyǒu de shēnghuó xíguàn hěn chà, wǒ yǐjīng rěnnài tā hěn jiǔ le, zhēn xīwàng tā mǎshàng bān zǒu.
examples.english: My roommate's living habits are very bad; I have tolerated him for a long time, and I really hope he moves out immediately.

examples.chinese: 那個老人真可憐，他已經三天沒吃飯了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge lǎorén zhēn kělián, tā yǐjīng sān tiān méi chīfàn le.
examples.english: That old man is really pitiful; he hasn't eaten for three days.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太雖然已經八十多歲了，可是身體還很健康。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai suīrán yǐjīng bāshí duō suì le, kěshì shēntǐ hái hěn jiànkāng.
examples.english: Although that old lady is already over eighty years old, her health is still very good.

examples.chinese: 快考試了，這本書的前幾課我已經複習完了，可是沒時間念後三課。
examples.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zhè běn shū de qián jǐ kè wǒ yǐjīng fùxí wán le, kěshì méi shíjiān niàn hòu sān kè.
examples.english: The exam is coming soon—I've already finished reviewing the first few lessons of this book, but I don't have time to study the last three lessons.

examples.chinese: 快考試了，這本書的前幾課我已經複習完了，可是沒時間念後三課。
examples.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zhè běn shū de qián jǐ kè wǒ yǐjīng fùxí wán le, kěshì méi shíjiān niàn hòu sān kè.
examples.english: The exam is coming soon—I've already finished reviewing the first few lessons of this book, but I don't have time to study the last three lessons.

examples.chinese: 為了做這個報告，經理已經跟我們開過三次會了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zuò zhège bàogào, jīnglǐ yǐjīng gēn wǒmen kāi guò sān cì huì le.
examples.english: In order to prepare this report, the manager has already had meetings with us three times.

examples.chinese: 那個學生已經一個星期沒來上課了，他發生了什麼事？
examples.pinyin: Nàge xuéshēng yǐjīng yī gè xīngqī méi lái shàngkè le, tā fāshēngle shénme shì?
examples.english: That student hasn't come to class for a week already; what happened to him?

examples.chinese: 他常常遲到，讓老闆很生氣。弟弟的房間又髒又亂，已經三個月沒打掃了，所以媽媽生他的氣。
examples.pinyin: Tā chángcháng chídào, ràng lǎobǎn hěn shēngqì. / Dìdi de fángjiān yòu zāng yòu luàn, yǐjīng sān ge yuè méi dǎsǎo le, suǒyǐ māma shēng tā de qì.
examples.english: He is often late, which makes his boss very angry. / Younger brother's room is both dirty and messy; it has been three months since it was cleaned, so mom is angry at him.

examples.chinese: 昨天朋友教我的那首英文歌，我已經學會了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān péngyou jiāo wǒ de nà shǒu Yīngwén gē, wǒ yǐjīng xuéhuì le.
examples.english: I have already learned that English song my friend taught me yesterday.

examples.chinese: 我父母這個週末都不在家，家裡只剩下我一個人。我已經把衣服洗完了，剩下的家事請你做。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ zhège zhōumò dōu bù zài jiā, jiālǐ zhǐ shèngxià wǒ yī ge rén. Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ yīfu xǐ wán le, shèngxià de jiāshì qǐng nǐ zuò.
examples.english: My parents are both not at home this weekend; only I am left at home. I have already finished washing the clothes; please do the remaining housework.

examples.chinese: 從昨天晚上到現在，已經下了十個小時的雨了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zuótiān wǎnshang dào xiànzài, yǐjīng xià le shí ge xiǎoshí de yǔ le.
examples.english: From last night until now, it has already rained for ten hours.

examples.chinese: 他在跟家人談事情，已經講了三十分鐘的話了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gēn jiārén tán shìqíng, yǐjīng jiǎngle sānshí fēnzhōng de huà le.
examples.english: He is discussing something with his family; he has already been talking for thirty minutes.

examples.chinese: 我已經坐了四、五個小時了，想出去走走！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng zuò le sì, wǔ gè xiǎoshí le, xiǎng chūqù zǒuzou!
examples.english: I have already been sitting for four or five hours, I want to go out and walk around!

examples.chinese: 我已經在台北住了三十年了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng zài Táiběi zhù le sānshí nián le.
examples.english: I have already lived in Taipei for thirty years.

examples.chinese: A:這些點心夠不夠？ B:夠了，夠了，我們已經吃過午飯了。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhèxiē diǎnxin gòu bu gòu? B: Gòu le, gòu le, wǒmen yǐjīng chī guo wǔfàn le.
examples.english: A: Are these snacks enough? B: Enough, enough; we have already eaten lunch.

examples.chinese: 這件事情，他已經告訴大家了。我今天做了很多事，現在累了，需要休息了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng, tā yǐjīng gàosu dàjiā le. Wǒ jīntiān zuò le hěn duō shì, xiànzài lèi le, xūyào xiūxí le.
examples.english: This matter, he has already told everyone. Today I did many things; now I am tired and need to rest.

examples.chinese: A:你已經決定明年去英國了嗎？ B:我還沒做決定。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yǐjīng juédìng míngnián qù Yīngguó le ma? B: Wǒ hái méi zuò juédìng.
examples.english: A: Have you already decided to go to England next year? B: I haven't made a decision yet.

examples.chinese: A:你寫功課了嗎？ B:我已經寫了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiě gōngkè le ma? B: Wǒ yǐjīng xiě le.
examples.english: A: Have you done your homework? B: I have already done it.

examples.chinese: 小安有一張娃娃臉，到哪裡都被當作大學生，誰知道他已經四十歲了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān yǒu yì zhāng wáwa liǎn, dào nǎlǐ dōu bèi dàngzuò dàxuéshēng, shéi zhīdào tā yǐjīng sìshí suì le.
examples.english: Xiao An has a baby face, so wherever he goes he is treated as a university student; who would know he is already forty years old.

examples.chinese: 我已經退休了，不過還時常跟幾位要好的同事通信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng tuìxiū le, bùguò hái shícháng gēn jǐ wèi yàohǎo de tóngshì tōngxìn.
examples.english: I have already retired, but I still often correspond with a few close colleagues.

examples.chinese: 我姑姑跟姑丈結婚已經有二十年了，感情一直很好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gūgu gēn gūzhàng jiéhūn yǐjīng yǒu èrshí nián le, gǎnqíng yīzhí hěn hǎo.
examples.english: My paternal aunt and her husband (my uncle) have been married for twenty years already, and their relationship has always been very good.

examples.chinese: 那輛腳踏車對個子小的我來說太高了，腳很難跨過去。我們大學前年起已開放跨校選課，增加各校的交流機會。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng jiǎotàchē duì gèzi xiǎo de wǒ lái shuō tài gāo le, jiǎo hěn nán kuà guòqù. Wǒmen dàxué qiánnián qǐ yǐ kāifàng kuàxiào xuǎnkè, zēngjiā gè xiào de jiāoliú jīhuì.
examples.english: That bicycle is too high for me, since I'm short, so it's hard to straddle my leg over it. Our university has offered cross-school course selection since the year before last, increasing opportunities for exchange between schools.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: A:聽說百貨公司的衣服要降價了，現在降了嗎？ B:夏天的衣服降價了，因為已經開始賣冬天的衣服了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō bǎihuò gōngsī de yīfu yào jiàngjià le, xiànzài jiàng le ma? B: Xiàtiān de yīfu jiàngjià le, yīnwèi yǐjīng kāishǐ mài dōngtiān de yīfu le.
examples.english: A: I heard that the department store's clothes are going to drop in price; have they dropped now? B: Summer clothes have dropped in price, because they've already started selling winter clothes.

examples.chinese: 他的獎學金申請書因少了一份資料，已被學校退回。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiǎngxuéjīn shēnqǐngshū yīn shǎo le yī fèn zīliào, yǐ bèi xuéxiào tuìhuí.
examples.english: His scholarship application was returned by the school because it was missing one document.

examples.chinese: 那件名牌長裙才兩千元而已，用不著跟老闆殺價。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn míngpái chángqún cái liǎngqiān yuán éryǐ, yòngbuzháo gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
examples.english: That brand-name long skirt is only two thousand yuan, that's all; there's no need to haggle with the shopkeeper.

examples.chinese: 我來臺灣，算起來才三個月而已，卻已去過十幾家茶館了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lái Táiwān, suàn qǐlái cái sān ge yuè éryǐ, què yǐ qùguo shí jǐ jiā cháguǎn le.
examples.english: In total, it has only been three months since I came to Taiwan, yet I have already been to more than ten tea houses.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠排出的廢氣很毒，附近已經有不少民眾生病了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de fèiqì hěn dú, fùjìn yǐjīng yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng shēngbìng le.
examples.english: The exhaust fumes emitted by that factory are very poisonous; many people nearby have already gotten sick.

examples.chinese: 那件事我已經跟你重複說過好多次了，你怎麼還問我？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn shì wǒ yǐjīng gēn nǐ chóngfù shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme hái wèn wǒ?
examples.english: I have already said that matter to you repeatedly many times; how come you are still asking me?

examples.chinese: 他說的話都很有道理，不是廢話，只是你聽不進去而已。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà dōu hěn yǒu dàolǐ, bù shì fèihuà, zhǐshì nǐ tīng bù jìnqù éryǐ.
examples.english: What he says is all very reasonable, not nonsense; it's just that you won't take it in.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的帳單已經加了服務費了，你不必再給小費。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de zhàngdān yǐjīng jiā le fúwùfèi le, nǐ búbì zài gěi xiǎofèi.
examples.english: This restaurant's bill already includes a service charge; you don't need to give a tip.

examples.chinese: 哎喲，已經半夜一點多了！我們就別再加班寫產品計畫了，等明天再繼續吧！
examples.pinyin: Āiyō, yǐjīng bànyè yìdiǎn duō le! Wǒmen jiù bié zài jiābān xiě chǎnpǐn jìhuà le, děng míngtiān zài jìxù ba!
examples.english: Woah, it's already past one in the morning! Let's stop working overtime to write the product plan, and continue tomorrow!

examples.chinese: 他的中文能力已達到相當好的水準，在臺灣念研究所沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén nénglì yǐ dádào xiāngdāng hǎo de shuǐzhǔn, zài Táiwān niàn yánjiūsuǒ méi wèntí.
examples.english: His Chinese ability has already reached a fairly good level; studying at a graduate school in Taiwan is no problem.

examples.chinese: 新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
examples.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng zài jīngguò zhuānmén de xùnliàn hòu, dōu yǐ néng shǐyòng gōngchǎng gè zhǒng shēngchǎn jīqì.
examples.english: After receiving specialized training, the new employees are all now able to use the various production machines in the factory.

examples.chinese: 經過兩段不幸的感情生活，那位女士對愛情已失去了信心。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò liǎng duàn bùxìng de gǎnqíng shēnghuó, nà wèi nǚshì duì àiqíng yǐ shīqù le xìnxīn.
examples.english: After two unfortunate romantic relationships, that lady has already lost confidence in love.

examples.chinese: 他只是開個小玩笑而已，你何必那麼在乎呢？
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐshì kāi gè xiǎo wánxiào éryǐ, nǐ hébì nàme zàihu ne?
examples.english: He was just making a little joke, why should you care so much?

examples.chinese: 我好友都已結婚了，什麼時候才換我辦喜事，請大家喝喜酒？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoyǒu dōu yǐjīng jiéhūn le, shénme shíhòu cái huàn wǒ bàn xǐshì, qǐng dàjiā hē xǐjiǔ?
examples.english: All my good friends are already married; when will it be my turn to hold a wedding and invite everyone to drink at the wedding banquet?

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，目前已被發現的蝴蝶大約有三百七十種以上。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, mùqián yǐ bèi fāxiàn de húdié dàyuē yǒu sānbǎi qīshí zhǒng yǐshàng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the butterflies that have been discovered so far number approximately over 370 species.

examples.chinese: 不管未婚或者已婚的人，在現實生活中都有需要面對的問題。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn wèihūn huòzhě yǐhūn de rén, zài xiànshí shēnghuó zhōng dōu yǒu xūyào miànduì de wèntí.
examples.english: Whether unmarried or married, people all have problems they need to face in real life.

examples.chinese: 我與高中同學已十多年沒見了，想找個適當時間邀請大家聚聚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǔ gāozhōng tóngxué yǐ shí duō nián méi jiàn le, xiǎng zhǎo ge shìdàng shíjiān yāoqǐng dàjiā jù ju.
examples.english: I haven't seen my high school classmates for over ten years; I want to find an appropriate time to invite everyone to get together.

examples.chinese: 祕書趁老闆不在把商品計畫偷走，這事已經交給法院處理了。
examples.pinyin: Mìshū chèn lǎobǎn bú zài bǎ shāngpǐn jìhuà tōu zǒu, zhè shì yǐjīng jiāo gěi fǎyuàn chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: The secretary took advantage of the boss's absence to steal the product plan; this matter has already been handed over to the court.

examples.chinese: 自從採用專家提供的方法後，茶葉的產量已增加百分之五十。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng cǎiyòng zhuānjiā tígōng de fāngfǎ hòu, cháyè de chǎnliàng yǐ zēngjiā bǎifēnzhī wǔshí.
examples.english: Since adopting the method provided by experts, the production output of tea leaves has increased by 50 percent.

examples.chinese: 現在已經沒有所謂的鐵飯碗了，有專業技術才有保障。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài yǐjīng méiyǒu suǒwèi de tiěfànwǎn le, yǒu zhuānyè jìshù cái yǒu bǎozhàng.
examples.english: Nowadays there is no so-called iron rice bowl anymore; only with professional skills can you have security.

examples.chinese: 算起來我們已經好久沒吃餃子了，買點兒麵粉、青菜和肉，回家包餃子吧。
examples.pinyin: Suàn qǐlái wǒmen yǐjīng hǎojiǔ méi chī jiǎozi le, mǎi diǎnr miànfěn, qīngcài hé ròu, huí jiā bāo jiǎozi ba.
examples.english: Counting it up, we haven't eaten dumplings for a long time; let's buy some flour, vegetables, and meat, and go home to make dumplings.

examples.chinese: 自從政府宣布石油、電費雙漲的作法以來，反對的民眾人數已近七成。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhèngfǔ xuānbù shíyóu, diànfèi shuāng zhǎng de zuòfǎ yǐlái, fǎnduì de mínzhòng rénshù yǐ jìn qī chéng.
examples.english: Since the government announced the policy of raising both oil and electricity prices, the number of people opposed has approached seventy percent.

examples.chinese: 他與妻子雖然已結婚多年，感情仍維持得很好，真令人羨慕。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǔ qīzi suīrán yǐ jiéhūn duō nián, gǎnqíng réng wéichí de hěn hǎo, zhēn lìng rén xiànmù.
examples.english: Although he and his wife have been married for many years, their affection is still maintained very well; it truly makes people envious.

examples.chinese: 這棟房子空間小，位置離市區又遠，所以價值三百萬而已。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng fángzi kōngjiān xiǎo, wèizhì lí shìqū yòu yuǎn, suǒyǐ jiàzhí sānbǎi wàn éryǐ.
examples.english: This house has little space and is far from the city center, so it is worth only three million.

examples.chinese: 雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā yǐjīng qīnzì shuō le duìbuqǐ, dàn háishì hěn hòuhuǐ zuòchū nàyàng méi lǐmào de xíngwéi, yúshì zàidù xiàng gèwèi dàoqiàn.
examples.english: Although he has already personally said sorry, he still very much regrets having behaved so impolitely, so he once again apologizes to everyone.

examples.chinese: 這家公司成立不到兩年，現在的規模已發展得十分完整。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chénglì bù dào liǎng nián, xiànzài de guīmó yǐ fāzhǎn de shífēn wánzhěng.
examples.english: This company was established less than two years ago, and its current scale has already developed quite completely.

examples.chinese: 這場棒球比賽已打到最後一局，可是仍無法看出誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bàngqiú bǐsài yǐ dǎ dào zuìhòu yì jú, kěshì réng wúfǎ kànchū shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: This baseball game has already reached the final inning, but it is still impossible to tell who will lose and who will win.

items.wordHook: A coiled loop snapped shut like a finished knot shows the cycle is 已(already) done.

examples.chinese: 信用卡的正面和背面都有一組號碼，在線上刷卡時用得到。
examples.pinyin: Xìnyòngkǎ de zhèngmiàn hé bèimiàn dōu yǒu yī zǔ hàomǎ, zài xiànshàng shuākǎ shí yòng de dào.
examples.english: Both the front side and the back of a credit card have a set of numbers; they are used when swiping the card online.

examples.chinese: 有一些口罩正面跟反面的差異很小，不過一般來說，正面的顏色較深，反面的顏色較淺。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē kǒuzhào zhèngmiàn gēn fǎnmiàn de chāyì hěn xiǎo, bùguò yībān lái shuō, zhèngmiàn de yánsè jiào shēn, fǎnmiàn de yánsè jiào qiǎn.
examples.english: For some masks, the difference between the front side and the reverse side is very small, but generally speaking, the front side is darker in color and the reverse side is lighter.

examples.chinese: A:聽說百貨公司的衣服要降價了，現在降了嗎？ B:夏天的衣服降價了，因為已經開始賣冬天的衣服了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō bǎihuò gōngsī de yīfu yào jiàngjià le, xiànzài jiàng le ma? B: Xiàtiān de yīfu jiàngjià le, yīnwèi yǐjīng kāishǐ mài dōngtiān de yīfu le.
examples.english: A: I heard that the department store's clothes are going to drop in price; have they dropped now? B: Summer clothes have dropped in price, because they've already started selling winter clothes.

examples.chinese: 國內幾家銀行決定從明年起，降低跨行匯款的手續費。
examples.pinyin: Guónèi jǐ jiā yínháng juédìng cóng míngnián qǐ, jiàngdī kuàháng huìkuǎn de shǒuxùfèi.
examples.english: Several domestic banks have decided that starting next year, they will lower the service fees for interbank remittances.

examples.chinese: 從明天起天氣會變冷，溫度會比今天降低五度，出門時最好穿上外套。
examples.pinyin: Cóng míngtiān qǐ tiānqì huì biàn lěng, wēndù huì bǐ jīntiān jiàngdī wǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo chuān shàng wàitào.
examples.english: Starting tomorrow, the weather will turn cold; the temperature will drop five degrees compared to today, so it's best to put on a jacket when going out.

examples.chinese: 水災過後應立刻打掃環境，才能降低傳染病流行的機會。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐzāi guòhòu yīng lìkè dǎsǎo huánjìng, cái néng jiàngdī chuánrǎnbìng liúxíng de jīhuì.
examples.english: After a flood, one should immediately clean up the environment; only then can the chance of infectious diseases spreading be reduced.

examples.chinese: 對學生來說，經常失眠可能降低學習效率。
examples.pinyin: Duì xuéshēng lái shuō, jīngcháng shīmián kěnéng jiàngdī xuéxí xiàolǜ.
examples.english: For students, frequent insomnia may reduce learning efficiency.

examples.chinese: 網路商店時常在過節時舉辦降價活動來吸引顧客。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn shícháng zài guòjié shí jǔbàn jiàngjià huódòng lái xīyǐn gùkè.
examples.english: Online stores often hold discount events during festivals to attract customers.

items.wordHook: The 阝(place) marks the spot; the 夅(descend) part shows the motion — 降(descend).

examples.chinese: 人類活動產生許多垃圾，不但汙染了環境，更改變了全球氣候。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi huódòng chǎnshēng xǔduō lājī, bùdàn wūrǎn le huánjìng, gèng gǎibiàn le quánqiú qìhòu.
examples.english: Human activities produce a lot of garbage, which not only polluted the environment but also changed the global climate.

examples.chinese: 工廠排水系統得設計好，以免汙染自然環境。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng pái shuǐ xìtǒng děi shèjì hǎo, yǐmiǎn wūrǎn zìrán huánjìng.
examples.english: The factory's drainage system must be well designed, lest it pollute the natural environment.

examples.chinese: 為了人民的健康，許多國家都禁止進口受到環境汙染的農產品。
examples.pinyin: Wèile rénmín de jiànkāng, xǔduō guójiā dōu jìnzhǐ jìnkǒu shòudào huánjìng wūrǎn de nóngchǎnpǐn.
examples.english: For the health of the people, many countries prohibit the import of agricultural products that have been polluted by the environment.

examples.chinese: 隨著空氣被汙染的情況越來越嚴重，得到癌症的機會也增加了。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kōngqì bèi wūrǎn de qíngkuàng yuèláiyuè yánzhòng, dédào áizhèng de jīhuì yě zēngjiā le.
examples.english: As the situation of air pollution becomes more and more serious, the chance of getting cancer has also increased.

examples.chinese: 解決環境受汙染的問題需要長久的計畫。
examples.pinyin: Jiějué huánjìng shòu wūrǎn de wèntí xūyào chángjiǔ de jìhuà.
examples.english: Solving the problem of environmental pollution requires a long-term plan.

examples.chinese: 自己做的肥皂用起來比較安心，也能選擇自己喜歡的氣味。
examples.pinyin: Zìjǐ zuò de féizào yòng qǐlái bǐjiào ānxīn, yě néng xuǎnzé zìjǐ xǐhuan de qìwèi.
examples.english: Soap made by yourself feels safer to use, and you can also choose the scent you like.

examples.chinese: 那個網站在拍賣手工肥皂，買一送一，蠻划算的。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wǎngzhàn zài pāimài shǒugōng féizào, mǎi yī sòng yī, mán huásuàn de.
examples.english: That website is auctioning handmade soap, buy one get one free—quite a bargain.

examples.chinese: 他勸我別太在意別人的眼光，把自己負責的事完成就好。
examples.pinyin: Tā quàn wǒ bié tài zàiyì biérén de yǎnguāng, bǎ zìjǐ fùzé de shì wánchéng jiù hǎo.
examples.english: He advised me not to care too much about others' opinions, and to just complete the things I am responsible for.

examples.chinese: 經過多次訓練，他總算贏得這場球賽的冠軍。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō cì xùnliàn, tā zǒngsuàn yíngdé zhè chǎng qiúsài de guànjūn.
examples.english: After many training sessions, he finally won the championship of this ball game.

items.wordHook: 健(strong) + 康(healthy) → strong and healthy: 健康(health).
a 王(jade) rests in 朱(cinnabar) light → a round 珠(pearl).
Combining 發(distribute) and 揮(direct): 發揮 means bring out innate or acquired qualities.
